pipelines.name: Build bws Docker image

steps.name: Generate Docker image tag
steps.run:
REF=${GITHUB_HEAD_REF:-${GITHUB_REF#refs/heads/}}
IMAGE_TAG=$(echo "${REF}" | sed "s#/#-#g")  # slash safe branch name
if [[ "${IMAGE_TAG}" == "main" ]]; then
  IMAGE_TAG=dev
fi

echo "image_tag=${IMAGE_TAG}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Create and push manifest list
steps.run:
IFS=',' read -r -a tags_array <<< "${TAGS}"
tag_args=()
for tag in "${tags_array[@]}"; do
  tag_args+=(-t "${tag}")
done

sources=()
for digest in *; do
  sources+=("${_AZ_REGISTRY}/bws@sha256:${digest}")
done

docker buildx imagetools create "${tag_args[@]}" "${sources[@]}"

DIGEST=$(docker buildx imagetools inspect "${tags_array[0]}" --format '{{json .Manifest}}' | jq -r '.digest')
echo "digest=${DIGEST}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Sign image with Cosign
steps.run:
IFS=',' read -r -a tags_array <<< "${TAGS}"
images=()
for tag in "${tags_array[@]}"; do
  images+=("${tag}@${DIGEST}")
done
cosign sign --yes "${images[@]}"
echo "images=${images[*]}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Log in to Azure for signing
Sign windows binary
steps.run:
SIGNING_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(az account get-access-token --resource https://vault.azure.net --query accessToken --output tsv)
if [[ -z "$SIGNING_ACCESS_TOKEN" ]]; then
  echo "::error::Failed to get a Key Vault access token for signing"
  exit 1
fi
echo "::add-mask::$SIGNING_ACCESS_TOKEN"

azuresigntool sign -v \
  -kvu "$SIGNING_VAULT_URL" \
  -kva "$SIGNING_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -kvc "$SIGNING_CERT_NAME" \
  -fd sha256 \
  -du https://bitwarden.com \
  -tr http://timestamp.digicert.com \
  ./target/${{ matrix.settings.target }}/release/bws.exe

steps.name: Get certificates
steps.run:
mkdir -p "$HOME/certificates"
az keyvault secret show --id https://bitwarden-ci.vault.azure.net/certificates/devid-app-cert |
  jq -r .value | base64 -d > "$HOME/certificates/devid-app-cert.p12"

steps.name: Set up keychain
steps.run:
KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
echo "::add-mask::$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD"

security create-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build.keychain
security default-keychain -s build.keychain
security unlock-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build.keychain
security set-keychain-settings -lut 1200 build.keychain

security import "$HOME/certificates/devid-app-cert.p12" -k build.keychain -P "" \
  -T /usr/bin/codesign -T /usr/bin/security -T /usr/bin/productbuild

security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple:,codesign: -s -k "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build.keychain

bump_version.name: Bump ${{ inputs.project }} Version to v${{ inputs.version_number }}

steps.name: Create Version Branch
steps.run:
NAME="version_bump_${GITHUB_REF_NAME}_${_PROJECT}_${_VERSION}"
git switch -c "$NAME"
git push -u origin "$NAME"
echo "name=$NAME" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Bump bws Version
steps.run:
cargo set-version -p bws "${_VERSION}"
# bump the version in install.sh
sed -i "s/DEFAULT_BWS_VERSION=\"[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\"/DEFAULT_BWS_VERSION=\"${_VERSION}\"/" ./crates/bws/scripts/install.sh
# bump the version in install.ps1
sed -i "s/\$defaultBwsVersion = \"[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\"/\$defaultBwsVersion = \"${_VERSION}\"/" ./crates/bws/scripts/install.ps1

steps.name: Bump go-sdk Version
steps.run:
# Extract current and new major versions
CURRENT_VERSION=$(cat ./languages/go/.version | grep -Eo "[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+")
CURRENT_MAJOR=$(echo "$CURRENT_VERSION" | cut -d. -f1)
NEW_MAJOR=$(echo "${_VERSION}" | cut -d. -f1)

echo "Current version: $CURRENT_VERSION (major: $CURRENT_MAJOR)"
echo "New version: ${_VERSION} (major: $NEW_MAJOR)"

# Check if this is a major version bump
if [ "$CURRENT_MAJOR" != "$NEW_MAJOR" ]; then
  echo "Major version bump detected: v$CURRENT_MAJOR -> v$NEW_MAJOR"

  # Special handling for v0/v1 -> v2+ transition (Go modules v0 and v1 don't use version suffix)
  if ([ "$CURRENT_MAJOR" = "0" ] || [ "$CURRENT_MAJOR" = "1" ]) && [ "$NEW_MAJOR" -ge "2" ]; then
    echo "Transitioning from v${CURRENT_MAJOR} (no suffix) to v${NEW_MAJOR} (with suffix)"

    # Update all .go, .mod, and .md files
    find ./languages/go -type f \( -name "*.go" -o -name "*.mod" -o -name "*.md" \) \
      -exec sed -i -e "s|github\.com/bitwarden/sdk-go/|github.com/bitwarden/sdk-go/v${NEW_MAJOR}/|g" \
                   -e "s|github\.com/bitwarden/sdk-go$|github.com/bitwarden/sdk-go/v${NEW_MAJOR}|g" \
                   -e "s|github\.com/bitwarden/sdk-go\([^/]\)|github.com/bitwarden/sdk-go/v${NEW_MAJOR}\1|g" {} +
  else
    # Standard case: v2+ -> v3+
    echo "Updating version suffix from v${CURRENT_MAJOR} to v${NEW_MAJOR}"

    # Update all .go, .mod, and .md files
    find ./languages/go -type f \( -name "*.go" -o -name "*.mod" -o -name "*.md" \) \
      -exec sed -i "s|github\.com/bitwarden/sdk-go/v${CURRENT_MAJOR}|github.com/bitwarden/sdk-go/v${NEW_MAJOR}|g" {} +
  fi

  # Special handling for example/go.mod: update version number in require statement
  echo "Updating version number in example/go.mod require statement"
  sed -i "s|\(github\.com/bitwarden/sdk-go[^[:space:]]*\) v[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\(.*\)|\1 v${_VERSION}\2|g" ./languages/go/example/go.mod
fi

# Always update the version file (for major, minor, and patch bumps)
sed -i "s/[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+/${_VERSION}/" ./languages/go/.version

steps.name: Check if version changed
steps.run:
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
  echo "changes_to_commit=TRUE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "changes_to_commit=FALSE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "No changes to commit!";
fi

steps.run:
git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"

git add .

    - [X] Other

    ## Objective
    Automated ${_PROJECT} version bump to ${_VERSION}")
echo "pr_number=${PR_URL##*/}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
